rdfs:label: worksFor
rdfs:comment: An organization the person currently works for.
notes: Use for current employment relationships. For past employers, use `urn:solid:alumniOf`. For looser group affiliations (clubs, mailing lists, project contributors), `urn:solid:memberOf` (org:memberOf, agent → organization) is more apt — `worksFor` implies an employment-like commitment. Note `urn:solid:member` runs the other way (group → agent), so the like-for-like comparison is `memberOf`. For FOAF-style data, `urn:solid:workplaceHomepage` links to the employer's homepage instead.

history.note: seeAlso/notes use urn:solid:alumniOf; added memberOf/workplaceHomepage and memberOf/alumniOf confusables.
